newsitem.title: FRANCE: Gang rapes, slashes policewoman on Paris train.
newsitem.headline: Gang rapes, slashes policewoman on Paris train.

text.p: Five men raped an off-duty policewoman on a Paris commuter train in mid-afternoon and slashed her with a linoleum cutter, a police union leader said on Friday.
The policewoman, out of uniform and unarmed, was on her way home from work on October 25 when the men approached her in a deserted car of an RER regional express train in a suburb south of Paris.

"Five men attacked her. When they opened her bag and saw she was a police officer, they went at her with a linoleum cutter, cutting her face and hands before they raped her," said Francis Mazamet, secretary general of the Difference police union.
The woman was found unconscious in her apartment four days later when her family became worried after not hearing from her. An investigation is under way.
